description: How the engineering roles around the design platform relate to each other: who sets standards, who submits and reviews designs, who provisions and governs the workspace, and which knowledge loops keep docs alive.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Provisioning seats, workspaces, and tooling budgets

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Design reviews, doc upkeep, and workspace controls day to day

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Standards, design decisions, and audit evidence

relations.name: Publishes reference architectures and templates
relations.description: Hands staff engineers reference architectures, shared shape libraries, and diagram templates as the starting frame for new designs.

relations.name: Submits designs for coherence review
relations.description: Submits system designs and migration plans for platform-architecture review so cross-team boundaries and standards stay coherent.

relations.name: Routes review load and assigns reviewers
relations.description: Schedules design reviews, assigns reviewers, and balances review load across senior engineers to keep delivery predictable.

relations.name: Communicates design decisions and risk
relations.description: Publishes visual design docs and review outcomes that give managers early sight of scope, dependencies, and delivery risk.

relations.name: Maintains living docs that speed onboarding
relations.description: Keeps architecture docs synced with the codebase so new engineers on the manager's teams onboard from current diagrams instead of stale wikis.

relations.name: Provisions licensed seats for engineers
relations.description: Approves and allocates platform seats and team workspaces from the engineering tooling budget so design work happens in one governed place.

relations.name: Enforces workspace access controls
relations.description: Applies SSO, SCIM provisioning, and permission policies to team workspaces so managers' spaces meet enterprise identity and data-handling rules.

relations.name: Feeds security requirements into standards
relations.description: Supplies data-classification, access, and retention requirements that the platform architect bakes into reference architectures and workspace conventions.

relations.name: Supplies architecture evidence for audits
relations.description: Provides current system diagrams and data-flow docs as audit evidence, giving compliance a trustworthy picture of how data moves.
